reasons: CS3244 is offered in Semester 2, so it is available in semester 8.

The prerequisites are satisfied: CS2040S covers the data structures requirement; ST2334 covers the probability/statistics requirement; MA1522 and MA1521 cover the linear algebra and calculus requirements.

However, CS3244 cannot be taken if completed CS3264 or CS2109S, and the student has completed both CS3264 and CS2109S. CS3244 is also mutually exclusive with CS3264 and CS2109S. Therefore the student is not eligible to take CS3244.
